clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Dismiss General Eko Hadi Over Illegal Wiretapping
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police ethics commission dismissed Irjen Eko Hadi Santoso following findings of illegal wiretapping and conspiracy.
The former official publicly expressed remorse and issued an apology during the ethics hearing while confirming his intent to file an appeal.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Continue Probe Into Illegal Wiretapping Of President
aiSummaryBullets: Brigadier General TK remains in special confinement as investigators probe their role in the unauthorized surveillance of President Prabowo Subianto.
The National Police Commission reported that an official identified as EHS has expressed regret following dismissal related to the wiretapping investigation.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Weighs Options For New Vice Presidential Nominees
aiSummaryBullets: Various political figures, including members of the Gerindra party, have emerged in discussions regarding the vice presidential vacancy.
Coalition parties have publicly stated that they leave the final selection of a candidate entirely to the President's discretion.

clusters.headline: Government Denies Mining Claims Within Ujung Kulon National Park
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources confirmed no mining permits exist within Ujung Kulon National Park territory.
Government officials stated that any potential Javan rhino relocation depends on comprehensive scientific studies, not external pressures.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Discusses Energy And Regional Cooperation At ASEAN Summit
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto highlighted Indonesia's commitment to energy independence by promoting B50 fuel and large-scale solar power projects.
The summit sessions included the ASEAN-Japan meeting and the East Asia Summit, where Prabowo emphasized international issues including Palestinian independence.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Investigate Treason Link In Illegal Surveillance
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesian police have upgraded the probe into the illegal surveillance of President Prabowo Subianto to the investigation stage.
Coordinating Minister Yusril Ihza Mahendra stated that investigators have identified connections between the surveillance and alleged treason.

clusters.headline: Police Dismiss Inspector General Eko Hadi Over Illegal Surveillance
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police Code of Ethics Commission dismissed Inspector General Eko Hadi Santoso.
The disciplinary action follows investigations into allegations of illegal surveillance involving the President.

clusters.headline: Sufmi Dasco Ahmad Gains Growing Support For Vice Presidency Role
aiSummaryBullets: Regional chapters of the Gerindra party and local community organizations have publicly declared support for Sufmi Dasco Ahmad as a vice presidential candidate.
Supporters cite his ability to bridge communication between political parties and his commitment to maintaining government stability as key qualifications.

clusters.headline: Indonesia U-17 Qualifies For 2027 AFC U-17 Asian Cup After Victory
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia U-17 defeated Afghanistan 4-0 to finish as Group A winners in the 2027 AFC U-17 Asian Cup qualifiers.
The victory ensured the team earned nine points across three matches with a clean sheet record.

clusters.headline: Government Confirms People School Will Not Use UI City Forest
aiSummaryBullets: The Minister of Social Affairs stated the School for the People project will not utilize land located in the University of Indonesia city forest.
The Governor of Jakarta formally opposed using the forest area for school construction, suggesting alternative sites in West and East Jakarta.

clusters.headline: Indonesian House Accelerates Legislative Bills Including Wiretapping
aiSummaryBullets: Commission III of the Indonesian House of Representatives aims to finalize the Wiretapping Bill by the end of 2026.
The legislative body has officially adopted the Bill on the Procedures for Law Formation as a House initiative.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Broadens Strategic International Partnerships
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto initiated potential collaborations with South Korea focused on critical mineral downstreaming and semiconductor manufacturing.
The Indonesian government is exploring opportunities with Japan regarding the development and processing of rare earth metals.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Regional Offices Remove Official Photos Of Gibran Raka
aiSummaryBullets: Government offices in Jakarta and North Sumatra have begun removing official portraits of Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
The removal process follows the vacancy of the Vice Presidential position after Gibran Rakabuming Raka officially resigned.

clusters.headline: Shin Tae-yong Praises Performance Of Arlyansyah Abdulmanan
aiSummaryBullets: Coach Shin Tae-yong described Arlyansyah Abdulmanan as a valuable asset for the future following his goal against Bali United.
The national team coach has been managing player fitness for Persija Jakarta amidst a demanding match schedule.

clusters.headline: Corruption Probe Reveals Illegal Fees In Immigration Visa Processing
aiSummaryBullets: A witness admitted to establishing nominee accounts to hold approximately 7.7 billion rupiah in funds from unauthorized visa processing.
Testimonies indicate that supplementary costs were charged at one million rupiah for each visa application filed.

clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Formally Resigns As Indonesian Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Gibran Rakabuming Raka has officially resigned from his position as the Vice President of Indonesia.
The resignation letter was submitted to the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) following a period of intense political activity.

clusters.headline: KPK Intensifies Corruption Probes Across Multiple Government Sectors
aiSummaryBullets: KPK investigators are examining regional officials regarding project procurement corruption in Klaten.
Witnesses linked to ATR/BPN land registry cases and Sumatra railway project allegations were summoned for questioning.

clusters.headline: Geological Agency Confirms No Tsunami Risk After Banda Sea Quake
aiSummaryBullets: A 7.1 magnitude earthquake struck the Banda Sea in Maluku on Tuesday morning.
Indonesian meteorological and geological agencies confirmed the event poses no tsunami risk.

clusters.headline: MPR Sets December 9 For Vice Presidential Election Selection Session
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR has officially scheduled the vice presidential selection and inauguration session for December 9, 2026.
President Prabowo is required to submit two candidates for the position no later than November 25, 2026.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Governor Demands Accountability For East Jakarta Mosque Attack
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung has officially called for strict legal consequences against the individual responsible for attacking worshipers.
The incident occurred during dawn prayers at the Darul Ma'arif mosque in East Jakarta, resulting in injuries to three individuals.
